reviews.title: Good and durable
reviews.comment: The pcie and the power sockets are very duarable. It worths for its price. I tested with my U5 245 and 64GB DDR5 ram and there is no issue.
reviews.author: awp4211

reviews.title: feels cheap and plasticky, but serves the purpose
reviews.comment: It serves my purpose, however the component quality feels cheap and kind of plasticky. If you press any of the connector or power connectors, I felt the board is slightly bending. Probably the materials or cheap. I am using it, but cautioning other buyers. ok for the price.
reviews.author: karthikc

reviews.title: Many internal ports
reviews.comment:
Good motherboard, very rich in functionality and ports. Really liked the new BIOS.
Important! - 3rd m.2 slot in on the back of the motherboard, might be not very useful, if usable at all.
reviews.author: YeA
